groups.saying_opens: أنه سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يخطب
مثل أبي زمعة عم الزبير بن العوام

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): saying 1 is the sermon, saying 2 is «مثل أبي زمعة»; both groups carry their saying label.
«عن أبيه» is a bare father, a relation link (rule 7).
The Prophet is the end of each chain (rule 12).
